BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                   OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy     )
Missouri Metro’s Request for Authority to            )      Case No. ER-2026-0143
Implement a General Rate Increase for Electric       )
Service

     ORDER GRANTING MOTION FOR CLARIFICATION AND EXPEDITED
                         TREATMENT

Issue Date: October 1, 2026                                   Effective Date: October 1, 2026

       On September 28, 2026, the Commission granted the motion of Evergy Metro, Inc.

d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (Evergy Metro) to strike portions of the direct testimony of a Staff

of the Commission (Staff) witness derived from a facility tour. The Commission authorized

Staff to file conforming testimony without the stricken testimony.

       On September 30, Staff filed a motion for clarification and expedited treatment. Staff

disagrees with the Commission’s decision and is unclear about what would constitute

conforming testimony. Staff asserts that some of the testimony that was struck was not tour

related.

       The Commission stated that Staff may file conforming testimony so that Staff could file

replacement testimony not reliant on tour information. If Staff believes that the Commission

struck information that was not tour derived, then it may include that information in

conforming testimony. Any objections to Staff’s conforming testimony will be addressed at the

evidentiary hearing when the testimony is offered.
        THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.      The Commission clarifies its September 28, 2026, order striking testimony as set

forth in the body of this order.

       2.      This order is effective when issued.

                                                          BY THE COMMISSION




                                                          Nancy Dippell
                                                          Secretary

John T. Clark, Senior Regulatory Law Judge,
